scripts.db:migrate:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env e2e --persist-to ../web/.wrangler/e2e
scripts.host-data:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --env="" --command "$(node scripts/scrub-host-data-cli.ts check)"
scripts.host-data:scrub: wrangler d1 execute DB --env="" --command "$(node scripts/scrub-host-data-cli.ts scrub)"
scripts.tsc: wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
